snippet.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2 - Announcement Trailer | PS4
snippet.description: Do you have what it takes to pilot a Mobile Suit? Create your hero and join players around the globe in 6v6 team online space battles in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2, coming to PS4 in 2019!
